newsitem.title: USA: Valassis names CEO Brandon as chairman.
newsitem.headline: Valassis names CEO Brandon as chairman.

text.p: Valassis Communications Inc said Wednesday it named President and Chief Executive Officer David Brandon to the additional post of chairman, replacing Brian Powers.
Powers, managing director of Consolidated Press Holdings Ltd (CPH), will remain with Valassis Communications as an outside director.

The changes follow CPH's sale of 20.2 million shares of Valassis stock, representing its entire ownership in the company. The shares were priced at $24 each and the transaction was completed July 2, the company said.

Valassis, a print media company which offers consumer promotion services, did not receive any of the proceeds from the offering. CPH, a privately held Sydney, Australia-based firm, sold about half of Valassis in an initial public offering in March of 1992. At the time of the sale last week, it owned about 50 percent.
As part of the deal, two CPH officials, Graham Cubbin and James Packer, have resigned from Valassis board. New directors have not yet been named.

"We see the sale of CPH's shares as a very positive sign for Valassis, increasing liquidity in the stock and gaining additional attention from the analyst and investment community," Brandon said in a statement.
Brandon added: "The outlook for 1997 is very positive, and we are working hard towards posting record earnings for 1998."
